items.title: 67247_J.C. Higginbotham oral history interview
items.q: He was with Luis Russel's band. ... So that was back in the 30s or something like that? Yeah, '29 or '30. ... Who were some of the other members in the band? ... Albert Nicholas.

ctx.x: I sure don't remember but I know it was a helluva record. I'll never forget that. Sy Oliver made the arrangements, yeah. I have them, too.
They always talk about your relationship with Little Albert, Red Allen, that you have been associated with-
I sent to him to come to New York.
